At the end of 5 years, if they haven't broken any laws, then they can apply for citizenship or reapply for another 5 years on the same program. For examples see Chinatown in San Francisco or Little Italy in New York City. These areas are known to have crime that reflects the same kind that normal people wanted to escape. If immigration is not controlled then we just end up with the problems of that other county here. It really is a complex problem with no easy solution and it is compounded by the fact we have terrible people in government, regardless of political affiliation.

[WP] You live in a future where humans are not the dominant species
What do you think about dominant species in the future?

“We weren't the dominant species. It didn't matter. That's what I always told them.

What makes a species dominant? No on has a straight answer. Is it area control? I don't think so. The Dolphin based Diyolfain control the oceans. 70% water but I rarely see one unless I'm taking a piss. You'd think they'd take themselves a little more seriously, and I know they could dominate, but most of them are just as content doing flips out there as they were in the aquariums of lore. I can't blame them then, who can argue with happiness?

What about the skies? Any study worth its salt will tell you that sky covers 100% of the Earth. Who better to roam the sky than the Crow based Cawkils? They have had their moments and their battles but none worth mention. They are still too flighty to be reliable and their black feathers stand out easily against that neon blue hue we all take for granted. Not at all expected from a species who travel in packs called murders. I wouldn't meet one on one in a dark alley though.

If it's not area control, is it strength? The Bear based Brontage are brawlers to the end. With claws that can rip through metal and jaws that do the same, very few of us have tried to encroach on their land. But then again, neither have they into ours. Intellect goes a long way in todays world and, as of yet, most of us seem to stand on equal ground.

If its not area control, strength, or intellect that makes the beast. Then what does?”

Nobody wanted to respond. Or maybe nobody had the answer. I did, “Raw primal violence and unrelenting force.”

The cave had been silent to begin with and now I could hear the rocks thinking.

“It's a bad time when scare tactics are no longer effective not because we are fearless but because we are at capacity. I am not here to scare you. You don't need me to be angry. I know that each one of you has already lost someone to any type of modified beast out there.”

Suddenly eyes began to turn up to me again.

“I'm tired. You are too. I know that absolutely everyone has a grudge against them but I think our best chance during all out war will be to side with the Humans.”

There were no gasps, no signs of disagreement, and no vocal concerns about my sanity but I could sense them.

“I know, we thought their plague had put them on the extinct list but I have found a group who is willing to lend a hand and act as diplomats for their species, should we find any more. They are like us, they are afraid, they are weak. But together, I think, we can start and end this war.”
